she dials the published service number
the ACD gives the agent the call, before any queue
the one recorder starts, and its notice plays
her number finds account 2231: a lookup, not proof
"This is the utility's automated assistant. How can I help?"
her record is read, and a fault ticket opened
a photo link goes by text; the photo lands at 20:13
the visit is booked for Tuesday at nine
the call ends; the agent's disposition, "visit booked by the agent," counts as a completed call in the platform's reports
had she asked for a person: back into the queue, with five fields and a whisper
